top_signals.title: Jupiter’s $3.6 Billion Fund Goes Defensive, Skirts Tech Selloff
top_signals.summary: An Asia-focused fund run by Jupiter Asset Management has beaten 89% of its peers this year, thanks to a pivot toward defensive stocks before the AI trade started unraveling in the summer, according to the fund’s co-manager Sam Konrad.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Asia-US West Coast container spot rates fall below $8,000 as US avoids LA-Long Beach port strike
top_signals.summary:
Trans-Pacific spot rates are slipping from peak-season highs after a tentative LA-Long Beach port labor deal. Trade-policy uncertainty and carrier capacity cuts could still keep prices elevated.
